facts.fact: The Daily Nation reports that the IEBC chairman gazetted 29 September 2025 for resuming continuous voter registration, letting Kenyans register, transfer, correct details or inspect their records at any of the 290 constituency offices.

The Standard reports a court order that the IEBC give parties and observers access to the source code and audit logs of its continuous voter registration system to monitor its ongoing operations, with biometric voter identification used in the 2026 by-elections.
A KPMG audit of the 2022 register, quoted in court, found 164,269 registrations with ID numbers invalid against National Registration Bureau records.

facts.fact: The article says Smartmatic supplied KIEMS kits used for biometric voter registration, electronic voter identification and result transmission in Kenya's 2022 general election, and that IEBC is targeting 6.3 million new voters ahead of 2027.
IEBC Commissioner Ann Nderitu says the voter register used in 2022 stands at 22.1 million voters and continuous registration with kits is under way in April 2026.

facts.fact: The IEBC chair said a new Biometric Voter Registration module had been integrated into the KIEMS system for the continuous voter registration launched in 2025, with 24,128 centres gazetted.
The IEBC says registered voters can check their details by SMS to 70000 or on its verification portal, which was back online on 8 July 2025 and shows polling station details and a PDF download.

facts.fact: IEBC says it rolled out all-biometric voter registration in all 290 constituencies in 2012, with 15,000 BVR kits at 24,614 centres registering 14,352,545 voters in about a month, data held on a central server.
IEBC says printed registers with voter photos are distributed to polling centres for people to check their details, and the register can be verified online and by SMS.

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that Smartmatic, contracted by Kenya's IEBC since 2021, supplied the Kenya Integrated Election Management System (KIEMS) biometric kits used in the 2022 general elections.
